posts.title: On Women of the Island: Minimalism and Making Things in the Age of AI
posts.summary: I was a guest on Women of the Island (小岛的女人们), a Chinese-language podcast about women living in New Zealand. We talked about minimalism, and about whether we still need to make things ourselves when AI can write code, animate and edit video.

posts.title: How to Get a Sound or Notification When Claude Code Finishes
posts.summary: Two ways to hear when Claude Code, Cursor or Codex stops or asks for permission: a five-line hook you write yourself, and echook, the open-source tool I built when the five-line version stopped being enough.

posts.title: An AI Agent Found Me: What a Personal Site Needs for Generative Search
posts.summary: A founder asked Claude Code to find an AI architect and it named me. What the site does for AI readers, what a SERP study later showed it was still missing, and the fixes: a name in the title, sameAs, Search Console and independent sources.

posts.title: Making a One-Take 3D Promo Film with three.js, Blender and Real Instrument Samples
posts.summary: How a 32-second, single-shot promo film for archlang was built: archlang code compiled to a plan, a Blender-built 3D house, one three.js html file where every frame is a pure function of time, a score mixed from CC0 instrument samples on the same beat table, verified sync, and a frame-by-frame render with simulated motion blur. Plus how I ran the whole project with an AI desktop assistant.

posts.title: A New iPhone Stuck at 1%: Error 1109, Apple Devices on Windows 11, and the iTunes Workaround
posts.summary: A brand-new iPhone 17e got stuck on the Apple logo at 1% when I updated it through the Apple Devices app on Windows 11. The log showed error 1109, a failed WKMS key fetch, and the restore-mode USB network interface failing to start. Reinstalling with classic iTunes fixed it in 14 minutes.

posts.title: An Agent-Friendly Knowledge Base for an Organisation: From Slack Exports to a Role-Gated Repo
posts.summary: A method for turning an organisation's Slack and platform exports into a private, role-gated repo that coding agents can read, cite and maintain without leaking data or obeying chat text.

posts.title: Animated SVG Project Cards for a GitHub README: A Field Guide
posts.summary: How to build a self-contained animated SVG that plays inside a GitHub README and shows a product doing its job: glyph-subset text, build-time evidence, shared keyframes, an interface redrawn in vectors, the product's own design system, and how to verify it.

posts.title: Suno Closed Its Public MP3. The Only Audio Left Won't Identify Itself.
posts.summary: In August every Suno song advertised two audio files: the familiar public MP3 and a second one I fetched, examined and could not identify. Three weeks later the MP3 is gone for every client I tried, and the manifest lists one entry. Here is the dated record from daily captures, what I got wrong along the way, and where I stopped.

posts.title: The Explore Feed That Froze
posts.summary: Suno's public /api/trending endpoint has returned the same 49 songs, all created in mid-September 2024, for roughly 22 months. This is the evidence from 84 consecutive daily automated captures, and what it says about the platform.

posts.title: Neon Auth Email Verification & Password Reset
posts.summary: Wiring Neon Auth's email-OTP verification and password-reset flows into a React + TypeScript frontend — the part Neon's dashboard enables but does not document, covering the type gap, the form state machine, and gating on emailVerified.

posts.title: Tokenless npm Publishing for AI Agents: The OIDC Trusted-Publishing Playbook
posts.summary: How to let a coding agent own the whole npm release lifecycle — version, tag, publish, verify — with no stored token and no 2FA prompt on any publish, using npm's trusted publishing over GitHub Actions OIDC.

posts.title: Neon Auth + Flask Integration Guide
posts.summary: Integrating Neon Auth (Better Auth) with a Flask backend: session-token handling when the token is not a JWT, multi-tenant post-auth routing, and the pitfalls hit during a production deployment.

posts.title: Stripe Payments + Cloudflare Workers Integration
posts.summary: Running Stripe checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, and the billing portal in a Next.js app deployed to Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext — including the server-side Stripe client changes Workers forces and the two-layer environment-variable setup.

posts.title: Migration Guide: Railway to DigitalOcean + Coolify
posts.summary: A complete record of moving a two-container Dockerized app (Next.js + LangGraph agent) off Railway onto a DigitalOcean droplet running Coolify, written as a reusable playbook: DNS and SSL, lessons learned, and a troubleshooting reference.

posts.title: Claude Code Audio Hooks: System Architecture
posts.summary: The architecture of claude-code-audio-hooks — an event-driven notification system designed to be operated by an AI agent rather than a human: no interactive prompts, NDJSON logs, and single-shot config.

posts.title: Notion API Integration Guide
posts.summary: How to use a Notion database as the backend for a community FAQ with voting and view analytics: schema, API routes, client-side implementation, caching, and a graceful fallback when Notion is unavailable.

posts.title: Driving Claude Code From Your Phone Over Telegram
posts.summary: Send a message from Telegram, have Claude Code execute it against the real files on your desktop, and get the result back on your phone — using Anthropic's official Channels plugin. Setup, the three rules that keep it working, and the silent failure that costs the most time.

posts.title: Upgrading PowerShell 7 Without Killing Your Claude Code Session
posts.summary: Installing a PowerShell 7 update from inside a Claude Code session force-closes the session, and opening a second terminal does not help. Why Windows Restart Manager does this, and three ways around it.

posts.title: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Strategy
posts.summary: The GEO strategy I designed for a static portfolio site — an audit of what AI answer engines could and couldn't see, then llms.txt and crawler infrastructure, page-level directives, structured data, and a plan for measuring any of it. Design, not results.

posts.title: SVG Animation Generation: Capsule-Render Integration
posts.summary: Techniques borrowed from capsule-render and rebuilt into Chromaflow's SVG generator: CSS-based text animation types, additional background styles, and the API surface that exposes them.

posts.title: Claude Code Skip Permission Confirmation
posts.summary: The options for reducing Claude Code's permission prompts — the per-session flags, fine-grained pre-authorisation in settings.json, and what a global bypass actually turns off.

posts.title: Making a Canvas Game Playable on Phones
posts.summary: Three things a desktop-built Canvas game needs before it works on a phone: a canvas that picks its resolution from the screen, touch coordinates corrected for canvas scaling, and a particle budget that scales down with the device.

posts.title: Automating a YouTube Video Showcase in a Profile README
posts.summary: A GitHub Actions workflow that regenerates the video cards in a profile README on a schedule, so the showcase never goes stale: channel ID, marker comments, card options, and the permission settings that trip people up.

posts.title: Four Bugs in One Vercel Blob Integration — Including a Firewall
posts.summary: Adding image uploads to a Next.js comment system produced four distinct bugs across several deploys, including one that only reproduces from mainland China. What the documented happy path leaves out, and why server-side put() beat the SDK's recommended client upload.

posts.title: The Developer's Guide: Configuring AWS SES for Bulk Email

posts.title: CopilotKit + LangGraph.js HITL Integration Guide

posts.title: Docusaurus Navbar Styling Guide: Lessons Learned

posts.title: AI Conversation Implementation Tutorial
posts.summary: Two working approaches to AI voice conversation compared side by side: sequential record-then-respond, and the OpenAI Realtime API with streaming. Covers the architecture of each, a comparison matrix, and setup guides for both.

posts.title: Fixing Google Fonts in Next.js 13+: A Pixel-Perfect Guide
posts.summary: Why CSS @import fails to load Google Fonts in Next.js 13+ and what to use instead: next/font/google in the root layout, font variables applied to the html element, and CSS updated to consume them.

posts.title: The AI Fluency Framework
posts.summary: A walkthrough of the 4D framework for working well with AI — Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence — together with the three modes of human-AI interaction, prompt-engineering techniques, and where generative AI currently falls short.

posts.title: The Future is Small: Why Small Language Models (SLMs) Are Powering the Next Wave of AI Agents

posts.title: Steal these Brand Secrets from Linear's CEO

posts.title: AI Chatbot Integration Guide for Website
